symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of positions along axis i of the array.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes and $q_i$ the number of positions along axis $i$, so $\boldsymbol q=(q_1,\dots,q_d)$.

symbols.name: index tuple
symbols.meaning: The index tuple of an entry of the array, with 0 <= j_i < q_i.
symbols.quote: An entry of the array $u$ has an index tuple $j=(j_1,\dots,j_d)$ with $0\le j_i<q_i$.

symbols.name: axis operator
symbols.meaning: An operator acting on sequences of length q_i, applied along axis i.
symbols.quote: For operators $G_i$ acting on sequences of length $q_i$, the tensor product $\bigotimes_i G_i$ applies $G_i$ to every line along axis $i$, for each $i$.

symbols.name: one-axis transform
symbols.meaning: The one-dimensional normalized discrete Fourier transform of length q_i.
symbols.quote: Here $F_{q_i}$ is the one-dimensional normalized [Discrete Fourier transform](dft.md) of length $q_i$, and $F_{\boldsymbol q}:=\bigotimes_iF_{q_i}$ is the tensor product of these.

symbols.name: multidimensional transform
symbols.meaning: The tensor product of the one-axis transforms F_{q_i}.
symbols.quote: Here $F_{q_i}$ is the one-dimensional normalized [Discrete Fourier transform](dft.md) of length $q_i$, and $F_{\boldsymbol q}:=\bigotimes_iF_{q_i}$ is the tensor product of these.

symbols.name: output index tuple
symbols.meaning: An output index tuple of the same shape as j.
symbols.quote: where $k$ is an output index tuple of the same shape as $j$.

symbols.name: resampling parameter
symbols.meaning: An integer parameter of the Gaussian resampling with 2 <= alpha < sqrt p.
symbols.quote: Let $p$ be the number of fractional bits of the stored values, $\alpha$ an integer parameter of the resampling with $2\le\alpha<\sqrt p$, and $\delta$ a fixed constant with $0<\delta<1/8$.

symbols.name: time exponent slack
symbols.meaning: A fixed constant with 0 < delta < 1/8 in the exponent of the running time.
symbols.quote: Let $p$ be the number of fractional bits of the stored values, $\alpha$ an integer parameter of the resampling with $2\le\alpha<\sqrt p$, and $\delta$ a fixed constant with $0<\delta<1/8$.
